Hi Elena — great to hear. Welcome — we look forward to working together.

Short answers and next steps (what we need from you):
1) Preferred payment method: ACH is preferred domestically. If you need wires for any international entities, please include full bank details and SWIFT/BIC for those accounts.
2) Remittance / invoice routing: Please send invoices to invoices@redwood-inference.com. For remittance confirmations, send remittance files to remittance@redwood-inference.com (CSV or PDF is fine).
3) PO requirements: We will issue a PO for the pilot. After that, PO numbers must appear on the invoice to guarantee automated processing.
4) Invoice format: PDF invoices (one invoice per PDF) attached to an email are acceptable. We also support Ariba/EDI for high-volume partners — let us know if you'd like to onboard there.

Required docs for vendor setup (please send these back):
- Completed W-9 or foreign equivalent (W-8)
- Voided check or bank letter confirming account
- Completed vendor setup form (we received yours, thanks)

I've attached our Vendor_Onboarding_Checklist.pdf and a banking template you can use to provide ACH or wire details.

For international wire routing/questions on currency conversion, looping in Marcus Lin (cc) who owns banking relationships.

Hi Elena,

Thanks for the docs — received and uploaded to the vendor intake queue. Answers below:

- Currency/wires: For foreign subsidiaries, we prefer invoices denominated in the currency you bill in; Redwood will process wires in the billed currency but the receiving bank determines conversion. For Spain (EUR), please include the EUR bank details and SWIFT. Our AP team will not automatically convert EUR to USD unless invoiced in USD.

- SFTP/EDI: We support SFTP drops for invoice batches but you will need to set up credentials and a folder naming convention. Ariba is supported as an alternate. For our SFTP onboarding we require (1) sample invoice PDF, (2) SFTP host/key, (3) sample file layout — we can share the template.

- PO policy: As Karthik noted — we'll issue a PO for the pilot. After that, invoices referencing an active PO will be routed to automated payment; invoices without a PO require manual approval and will be slower.

A couple of other notes:
- First payment for brand-new vendors can take up to 45 days while bank verification and controls complete; subsequent payments fall into standard Net30 terms.
- Redwood does not cover intermediary bank fees for incoming international wires. Please indicate if you'd prefer gross or net payment.

I'll attach our international wire instruction doc for Marcus to confirm routing.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
